questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.e: “donations” đuôi -s đọc /z/ (sau âm hữu thanh /n/); “benefits”, “robots”, “laptops” đọc /s/ (sau /t/, /p/).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.e: “technology” có “ch” đọc /k/; “charity”, “chore”, “children” đọc /tʃ/.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.e: “volunteer” /ˌvɒlənˈtɪə/ nhấn âm 3; “disabled”, “important”, “donation” nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.e: “useful” /ˈjuːsfl/ nhấn âm 1; “invention”, “computer”, “device” nhấn âm 2.

questions.t: Unit 4: For a better community – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Our class decided to ______ money to help children in remote areas.
questions.e: raise money: quyên góp, gây quỹ; “rise”, “arise” là nội động từ, không có tân ngữ.

questions.t: Unit 4: For a better community – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The volunteers helped ______ people, such as the elderly and the disabled, in the village.
questions.e: Trước danh từ “people” cần tính từ: disadvantaged (thiệt thòi, khó khăn).

questions.t: Unit 4: For a better community – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Taking part in community activities brings teenagers many ______, such as learning new skills and making new friends.
questions.e: Sau “many” cần danh từ số nhiều: benefits (lợi ích).

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The telephone was one of the most important ______ of the 19th century.
questions.e: “one of the most important + danh từ số nhiều” chỉ vật được phát minh → inventions.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Robots and ______ intelligence are changing the way we live and work.
questions.e: Cụm “artificial intelligence” (AI) = trí tuệ nhân tạo.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
My aunt is a ______; she stays at home, does the housework and looks after the children.
questions.e: homemaker: người nội trợ, ở nhà làm việc nhà và chăm sóc gia đình.

questions.t: Unit 2: Humans and the environment – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Planting more trees is a good way to ______ the effects of climate change.
questions.e: reduce the effects: giảm tác động (của biến đổi khí hậu).

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The concert was so successful that the band was invited to ______ again the following year.
questions.e: perform: biểu diễn – phù hợp với ban nhạc được mời trở lại.

questions.t: Unit 4 – Grammar: Past simple vs past continuous
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
While we ______ trees in the park, it started to rain.
questions.e: Hành động đang diễn ra (While…) thì bị hành động khác xen vào → quá khứ tiếp diễn: were planting.

questions.t: Unit 4 – Grammar: Past simple vs past continuous
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
When the volunteers arrived at the village, the children ______ football in the yard, so they stopped and ran to welcome them.
questions.e: Bọn trẻ đang chơi bóng (đang diễn ra) thì tình nguyện viên đến; “stopped” cho thấy việc chơi đã diễn ra trước → were playing.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Alexander Graham Bell ______ the telephone in 1876.
questions.e: Có thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ (in 1876) → quá khứ đơn: invented.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
My grandfather ______ this laptop since 2020, and it still works well.
questions.e: “since 2020” → hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ, kéo dài đến hiện tại → hiện tại hoàn thành: has used.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
I ______ never ______ a 3D printer before. This is my first time.
questions.e: Trải nghiệm tính đến hiện tại với “never … before”, “first time” → hiện tại hoàn thành: have never used.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
My brother enjoys ______ new apps on his smartphone, and he hopes ______ an inventor in the future.
questions.e: enjoy + V-ing; hope + to V → enjoys trying, hopes to become.

questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Every year, thousands of tonnes of plastic ______ into the ocean.
questions.e: Nhựa “bị” vứt xuống biển, sự việc lặp lại hằng năm → bị động hiện tại đơn: are thrown.

questions.t: Unit 3 – Grammar: To-infinitives and bare infinitives
questions.q:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Our teacher lets us ______ our own songs in music lessons.
questions.e: let + O + V nguyên mẫu không “to” → lets us choose.

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Anna: “Thank you so much for helping me with the charity event.”
Ben: “______”
questions.e: Đáp lại lời cảm ơn: “It's my pleasure.” (Rất hân hạnh/Không có gì).

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Nam: “What do you think about using robots to do the housework?”
Hoa: “______”
o: I think it's a great idea because it saves time.
questions.e: Câu hỏi xin ý kiến → trả lời bằng quan điểm cá nhân kèm lí do.

questions.q:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.
a. Lan: Really? What did you do there?
b. Minh: I went to a village in Ha Giang as a volunteer.
c. Minh: We taught English to the children and helped repair their school.
d. Lan: Minh, what did you do during the summer holidays?
questions.e: Hỏi về kì nghỉ (d) → kể đi tình nguyện (b) → hỏi đã làm gì (a) → trả lời cụ thể (c).

questions.q:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
a. Today, it is used not only for calling but also for studying, shopping and entertainment.
b. The smartphone is one of the most useful inventions of modern times.
c. However, spending too much time on it can harm our health and relationships.
d. Therefore, we should use it wisely.
e. With just a few touches, we can find information about almost anything.
questions.e: Câu chủ đề (b) → công dụng ngày nay (a) → bổ sung lợi ích (e) → However: mặt trái (c) → Therefore: kết luận (d).

questions.q:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Of all the inventions of the past few decades, artificial intelligence (AI) may have the greatest impact on our daily lives. AI refers to computer systems that can perform tasks which normally require human intelligence, such as recognising speech, translating languages and making decisions.

AI is already all around us. When you ask a virtual assistant about the weather, or when a music app suggests songs you might like, you are using AI. In hospitals, AI programs help doctors detect diseases earlier by analysing thousands of medical images in a few seconds. In education, AI-powered apps can create lessons that suit each student's level and learning speed.

However, this powerful technology also raises some concerns. Some people worry that AI will replace humans in many jobs, especially those that involve repetitive tasks. Others are concerned about privacy, since AI systems often collect large amounts of personal data. There is also the risk that students depend on AI too much and stop thinking for themselves.

Experts believe that AI itself is neither good nor bad; what matters is how we use it. Therefore, young people should learn how AI works and use it responsibly, as a tool to support their learning rather than to replace it.

Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
questions.e: Bài nói về AI là gì, ứng dụng (lợi ích), mối lo ngại và cách dùng hợp lí.

questions.t: Error identification – Past simple vs past continuous
questions.q:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
While my mother (A) was cooking dinner, my father (B) was coming home (C) and (D) gave her a big surprise.
questions.e: Hành động xen vào hành động đang diễn ra dùng quá khứ đơn: was coming → came (song song với “gave”).

questions.q:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
My sister (A) has (B) worked as a volunteer (C) for 2020, and she (D) loves helping others.
questions.e: Mốc thời gian (2020) đi với “since”, không dùng “for” → for → since.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
I started using this smartphone two years ago.
o: I have used this smartphone for two years.
I haven't used this smartphone for two years.
I used this smartphone for two years ago.
I have used this smartphone since two years.
questions.e: started V-ing … ago = have + V3 … for + khoảng thời gian → have used … for two years.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
Mai said, “Why don't we donate our old books to the school library?”
o: Mai suggested donating our old books to the school library.
Mai promised donating our old books to the school library.
Mai refused to donate our old books to the school library.
Mai suggested to donate our old books to the school library.
questions.e: “Why don't we…?” là lời đề nghị → suggest + V-ing: suggested donating.
